item.title: September 2026 Humble Choice
item.description:
Frostpunk 2


Genres: Strategy, Simulation

Platforms: mac, windows

Retail price: 44.99 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 78% positive, 9652 reviews

Search on Steam

Frostpunk 2 is a chilling take on the city‑builder genre where you’ll face not only the elements, but the struggles and power struggles of your growing population. You play as the Steward trying to find stability in the wake of a post‑apocalyptic event 30 years prior, and every decision you make impacts everyone. Build alliances within packed Council walls and temper the ambitions of power‑hungry factions in a deep story mode. See to the needs of your people by collecting heating elements like oil and coal, and sourcing the food and shelter needed to survive the endless winter. The need for warmth adds a new layer of depth to the resource‑management element of your fight for another day. Customize your own maps, models, and scenarios inside the game with full mod support using the FrostKit, too. Can you survive the cold? Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS


Genres: Action

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 49.99 USD

Steam: overwhelmingly positive, 96% positive, 8983 reviews

Search on Steam

The Blue Blur is back with an epic collection of his greatest classic adventures and two unique experiences that push the limits of speed! Play as Shadow in an all‑new story campaign featuring the freshest and fastest abilities yet! In The Return of Shadow, Shadow must confront his painful memories of the past and a reemerging threat. And Shadow Evolved sees Shadow master five new Doom Powers to surf, fly, and freeze time to save the day. Sonic x Shadow Generations also comes packed with a complete remaster of the beloved time‑traveling adventure, SONIC GENERATIONS, a greatest‑hits collection of classic 2D and 3D Sonic stages with new bonus stages and content! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Voidtrain


Genres: Action, Indie, Adventure, RPG, Simulation

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 29.99 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 72% positive, 4352 reviews

Search on Steam

All aboard the Interdimensional Express—next stop, Voidtrain! Discover a strange new world filled to the caboose with creatures, enemies, and weird places. You play as an engineer trapped within a mysterious world filled with unique floating islands, puzzles, and untold dangers. Build and upgrade your own locomotive, craft powerful weapons, and fight off various enemies to survive long enough to escape this endless void. Take on the solo campaign or play online co‑op with up to four friends. Punch your ticket to fun and intrigue in this open‑world survival‑craft experience. But be cautious not to fall off the tracks! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Ballionaire


Genres: Indie, Strategy

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 12.34 USD

Steam: very positive, 85% positive, 1870 reviews

Search on Steam

Cute, kinetic, and hilariously weird—Ballionaire is a one‑of‑a‑kind take on the traditional Japanese arcade game but with a physics and cash twist! The chaos is irresistible as you build the perfect pachinko board and trigger insane combos. The roguelike elements make each run unique and totally unpredictable—will your triggers spawn the ultimate scoring machine or lay an egg? Experiment with new boards and multipliers to appease the Elders and stay in good fortune with fate. Your journey to billionaire status is only a trigger or boon away. Find out if you have the luck needed for the perfect run and endless dough! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

GUNTOUCHABLES


Genres: Action, Indie

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 4.99 USD

Steam: mostly positive, 75% positive, 309 reviews

Search on Steam

Let the shell casings fly in GUNTOUCHABLES, the 1–4 player co‑op roguelike shoot‑’em‑up with cartoon‑y chaos behind every bullet. Lock in with your squad because you’ll need flawless teamwork and split‑second decision‑making to advance through wave after wave of bloodthirsty enemies. Complete mission objectives and collect upgrades for cash and perks to increase your chances of survival against foes that adapt just as well as you do. Buff your guns with clever combinations of perks and mods to turn your potato‑shaped protagonists into unstoppable mutant‑killing machines. The creators of GUNTOUCHABLES want your input, too—join their Discord community and help make every shot special! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Urban Jungle


Genres: Indie, Simulation

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 11.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 91% positive, 493 reviews

Search on Steam

Urban Jungle cranks the cozy dial up to 11 with colorful puzzles and adorable decorating gameplay. Turn your house into a special home with smartly placed fauna and watch your urban jungle grow! Don’t worry about watering or pest control—simply place your plants in a well‑lit corner and watch them thrive! Each new vine wraps your environment in a warm layer of green tranquility that offers a nice change of pace from other genres. Get the most out of your home with interactive lamps, humidifiers, and most importantly—adorable cats! Enjoy the relaxing atmosphere of your own urban jungle today! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum


Genres: Indie, Adventure, RPG

Platforms: mac, windows

Retail price: 19.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 92% positive, 1563 reviews

Search on Steam

Delve into the enchanting world of Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that’ll take you on an engrossing story of self‑discovery. Battle through a mysterious realm of wonder and darkness where dreams intertwine and secrets lurk around every corner. Explore the vivid 2D world’s gorgeous retro anime‑inspired art style with a mesmerizing soundtrack accompanying you throughout each adventure. Recruit memorable companions on your journey that concludes with multiple endings depending on your choices and actions! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action


Genres: Indie, Adventure, RPG

Platforms: windows

Retail price: 19.99 USD

Steam: very positive, 83% positive, 223 reviews

Search on Steam

Become the headliner and hero to your silent setting of Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action. One hundred forty‑one years in the future, man colonizes Saturn, bans music, and zaps society of individuality. Make a ruckus and turn heads in this unforgiving turn‑based rhythm JRPG with a cyberpunk spin! Inspired by genre icons like Chrono Trigger, you play as singer/songwriter BOBO. Stick it to “the man” in random‑encounter‑free combat where timing is everything, from parries to power‑ups. Choose your alliances with tact and overthrow the Saturnian Satellites, the ultimate form of law, and rock out in the process! Keys expire. Please redeem your key before April 6th, 2027.

Eldritch Escape Playtest


Genres: Action, Indie, RPG

Platforms: windows

Search on Steam

In this Lovecraftian Extraction Bullet Heaven, Earth has been consumed by an ancient eldritch god. Form a customizable squad of survivors and explore decaying, metroidvania-inspired worlds trapped within the god’s belly. Battle endless waves of nightmarish creatures, extract resources, rescue survivors, uncover forbidden knowledge, and search for a way out. This limited time Playtest is an Extra, and DOES NOT provide the game upon its release Keys are available on a first come, first serve basis. Playtest runs from September 8th to September 29th.
